2604.10992 ArtiCAD (Δ16.25): final 50.0 (sol 61.25, son55 45.0). G → son55 2: the CAD capability gap is concrete, but the in-scope retained object (experience store) gets no memory/case-reuse neighbour or residual. M → sol 3: the connector contract makes a separating prediction that the late-prediction ablation confirms; the store is generic case RAG and the O(1)/Markov-blanket argument is asserted. X → son55 2: store admission, retrieval size, versioning and ArtiCAD's own repair limits are unspecified, and the paper has no appendix or prompts. E.measurement → son55 2: the main benchmark is VLM-judged only, Krippendorff α 0.58–0.64 is called 'robust', Gemini-3-Pro is both judge and the backbone of the Pro row, and Succ only checks compilation. Store effect: quality deltas ≤0.05 on a 1–5 scale; iterations 4.4 → 3.1; 'improves success rates' is not shown (Succ 100% with and without the store; shared correction).

2604.11610 CluE (Δ1.25): final 70.0 (= son55). E.cost → son55 3: wall time, optimiser calls and evaluation calls for all four optimisers, and the closest baseline (MemEvolve) is matched on evaluation calls (1,150) with identical hyperparameters; tokens/dollars and a matched-optimiser-call control are absent. Opus corrections: son55's 'App. C prompts are images' is wrong (Figures 5–14 are text listings in the pinned material); son55's F4 'partial' revised to met, since the two LLM-judged sets (LongMemEval, ToolBench) are OOD test sets that are never used for selection.

2604.11811 M* (Δ3.75): final 72.5 (= sol; son55 76.25). M → son55 3 (reflection vs plain mutation untested; static-subset fitness is loose: LoCoMo seed 1 has the lowest validation score, 0.273, but the highest test score, 0.463). X → son55 4 (search space, runtime constraints, compile-fix, softmax parent sampling, subset construction, retention rule and evolved listings are all in text). E.measurement → sol 2 (4 of 7 configurations are scored by gpt-5.4-mini rubric judging, the same model as the task agent and as the search fitness; no judge validation). E.statistics → sol 2 (five search seeds on 3/7 configurations without intervals or tests; Table 1 reports seed 0, which is above the mean; ALFWorld Unseen rates are multiples of 1/42 while Table 5 states 50 test episodes). The abstract's 'all evaluated tasks' is contradicted by ALFWorld Seen (0.700 vs GEPA+VS 0.820).

2604.12231 Thought-Retriever (Δ7.5): final 46.25 (= son55). E.holdout → son55 1: thought-construction queries are LLM-generated from each paper's title and abstract (App. D), the abstract is the Abstract-single label, the memory-building protocol of Table 2 is never stated, no overlap audit is reported, and the method beats a ground-truth-selected oracle; only App. Q (disjoint 50/50 split, about 15 test cases per set) is a clean retained test. M → son55 2: retention is decided by the generator's own binary confidence, with no outcome signal. The 'consistently outperforms all baselines' claim fails on Gov Report F1 (0.232 vs OpenOrca 0.244, Nous Hermes 0.238, Full Context left 0.234).

2604.13533 EEAgent (Δ1.25): final 40.0 (sol 41.25, son55 42.5). M → son55 2 (LLM generality and consistency judgements are untested assumptions; Algorithm 1 has an 'or' retry guard and calls F_ei for planning). E.causality → son55 2 (the Vanilla EA control and CoT/SC alternatives on the same agent exist; component ablation and retry/budget parity are missing; run precedent). E.holdout → sol not_reported 0: no construction/evaluation split and no generalisation tier are stated, and failed tasks are retried up to 3 times using the simulator's success signal, with no statement of whether post-retry success is scored. E.statistics and E.cost are not_reported in both seats (re-checked).

Every move is recorded in the affected expectation's note and in the resolution of the colliding ID.
